# SSH sessions between OpenSSH's ssh and this library's server,
# recorded on loopback by scripts/check_ssh_server.py --record.
#
# Each session ran with the server's randomness drawn from a
# counter seeded with `seed`, so tests/test_ssh_server_sessions.rs
# can feed the `C` lines (what ssh sent) to a server seeded the same
# way and require it to produce the `S` lines exactly. The server
# offered every algorithm it has; the client's options chose.
# The keys exist only for this file. Do not edit: a changed byte
# is a session ssh never had.
#
# sessions: 15
